* Job Purpose

Axis Bank’s affluent business offers a range of financial investment products and provides customised solutions to create and manage the wealth of their niche segment clients, who are NRI, HNW [YP1] and Ultra HNW individuals, groups and establishments. Hence it requires higher order knowledge of the financial industry and other financial products.

**Job Context**
**Bancassurance**
is the insurance distribution
**model**
wherein the bank allows an insurance company to sell its products to the bank’s client base. ABSLI tied up with AXIS Bank in March 2024 to sell its insurance products through the Branch Banking.
  
  
**Open Architecture**
model empowers the customers now to select their Life insurance plans from more than one insurer as per their choice at competitive prices. It also lowers chances of Mis selling, with the intervention of multiple regulators like Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI).

* Principal Accountabilities

**Accountability**
Supporting Actions
  
  
**Business Targets –**
To achieve Business Targets on focused Business parameters like premium, SP/branch activisation, product mix and Persistency thereby contributing to the overall Business Growth and profitability.
  
  

* Work closely with AXIS Bank Burgundy Relationship Managers to provide a bouquet of products and investments to their HNI and Ultra HNI client base.
* Provide sound financial, insurance and wealth-management services to protect client assets and grow the net worth of their respective portfolios.
* Ensure quality of business and persistence.
* Ensure to increase SP Activisation and selling of greater NOPs through the Team of FLS for greater distribution of ABSLI products
* Ensure selling of right Product Mix as defined by the organisation to achieve overall business growth and profits.
* Identify and implement new business opportunities within the allocated area to enhance penetration
* Implement activities / programs designed at the organisational level to build great visibility, promote branding, and strengthen our relationship with the bank.
* Train and appraise the RM’s on ABSLI products thereby creating a mind space and easy recall for them.
* Ensure right method of business acquisition and absolutely 0 % mis selling

**Pre and Post-Sales Support and Service:**
To provide efficient and best in class, competitive products and services to both the Bank partner and customers
  
  

* Provide pre and post-sales support.
* Regularly review any customer complaints, plug gaps & ensure reduction in complaints
* Build effective relationship with the bank partner and become their first preferred insurer
* Create visibility and obtain credibility amongst the RMs, by presenting a strong knowledge base of not only the Life insurance products but also all other financial products and offerings.
* Plan and achieve business targets in terms of premium, RM activation and market share
* Establish efficient methods to respond to customer queries and maintain persistency levels.

**Partner relationship Management:**
To build and strengthen the relationship with the partner bank and become their preferred partner
  
  

* To be equipped with Bank’s product ranges and their key features along with the ABSLI products
* Pay regular visits to bank branches and meet bank partners.
* Design differential strategies to gain mindshare and product mix basis the potential of the branch
* Help the Bank branches to increase their overall LI pie
* Liaison with our Regional and Zonal Training Team and ensure periodic product training and branding within the branch for bank staff
* Design and launch various contests and appreciation platforms for the bank staff to achieve higher engagement

Focus on Business Quality and Profitability – Achieve Business profitability by focusing on renewals, quality of business and managing costs
  
  

* Ensure achievement of profitability and persistency targets for the relationship in the designated zones
* Manage expenses within allowable expense gap
* Plan and manage the renewals and ensure adequate focus is maintained by the sales Team on persistency
* Ensure Business Leakage is within allowable limits.
* Focus and Monitor Product Mix within the Circle, to achieve Channel Targets
* Job Purpose of Direct Reports

To represent ABSLI at the designated branches and is responsible for sales performance, acquisition of new business and relationship management in the assigned area / branches.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Executive \& CEO Office Assistant** 




  





**Company:** 
 Computeconnect Innovations LLP
 



**Product:** 
 BIZNTL
 



**Location:** 
**HiLITE Business Park, Kozhikode** 




**Work Mode:** 
**Full\-time \| Work From Office** 




**Experience:** 
**1–2 Years** 




**Reports To:** 
 CEO
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **smart, organised and commercially aware HR Executive \& CEO Office Assistant** 
 to work closely with the CEO.
 



 This is not a conventional HR role. The position combines
 **CEO\-office coordination, executive assistance, inside sales, client follow\-up, management coordination and selected HR responsibilities** 
 .
 



 The candidate should be comfortable communicating with
 **clients, business owners, senior executives, employees and candidates** 
 , while taking ownership of follow\-ups and day\-to\-day coordination.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage the CEO’s meetings, calendar, follow\-ups and important action items.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings and prepare brief meeting notes.
* Draft professional emails, WhatsApp messages and business communication.
* Follow up with prospects and existing clients through calls, WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn.
* Support inside sales by identifying prospects, decision\-makers and converting contacts into meetings.
* Maintain client and prospect follow\-up records.
* Coordinate between the CEO, employees, sales team and other departments.
* Track deadlines, commitments and management priorities.
* Support recruitment, candidate screening, interviews, onboarding and basic HR activities.
* Handle confidential business and employee information professionally.



 The role follows the existing BIZNTL CEO\-office approach of combining executive communication, meeting coordination, structured follow\-up and business relationship development.
 



**Who We’re Looking For** 



* **1–2 years of relevant experience.**
* Experience in
 **CEO/Founder’s Office, Executive Assistance, Inside Sales, Business Development, Client Management, HR or Operations** 
 .
* **Startup experience will be strongly valued.**
* Experience handling clients or senior stakeholders is preferred.
* Excellent English and good Malayalam communication.
* Strong organisation, follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Comfortable with LinkedIn, email, spreadsheets, calendars and CRM tools.
* High ownership, maturity, discretion and professional judgement.



 The existing BIZNTL profile similarly emphasises executive communication, organisation, ownership and confidentiality.
 



**Role Focus** 




**35% CEO Office \& Executive Assistance** 




**30% Inside Sales \& Client Coordination** 




**20% Management \& Internal Coordination** 




**15% HR \& Recruitment** 




**Important** 




 This is a
 **Work From Office position at HiLITE Business Park, Kozhikode** 
 . Candidates should be based in Kozhikode or willing to relocate and attend the office regularly.
 



**The opportunity:** 
 Work directly with the CEO and grow towards a broader
 **CEO Office / Founder’s Office / Business Operations / Management role** 
 .

title: ECOMMERCE CHANNEL SPECIALIST
description:
WE’RE HIRING \| ECOMMERCE CHANNEL SPECIALIST
 




  






 Helett Enterprises LLP is looking for an experienced Ecommerce Channel Specialist to manage and grow our Amazon marketplace business, with a strong focus on international Amazon marketplaces.If you have hands\-on experience in Amazon Seller Central, PPC, catalog management, account health, and international marketplaces, this could be the right opportunity for you.
 




  






 💼 Position Details
 





 Designation: Ecommerce Channel Specialist
 





 Location: HiLITE Business Park, Calicut, Kerala
 





 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| Permanent
 





 Work Mode: In\-Person
 





 Experience: 2\+ Years in Amazon Marketplace
 





 Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000/month
 





 Relocation: Mandatory
 




  






 🌍 Key Responsibilities
 





 • Manage daily operations of Amazon Seller Central
 





 • Manage Amazon UK, Europe, GCC, and other international marketplaces
 





 • Plan, manage, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns
 





 • Manage product listings, catalog, keywords, and SEO
 





 • Monitor pricing, Buy Box, promotions, and product visibility
 





 • Track ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, sales, and profitability
 





 • Manage Amazon Account Health, cases, appeals, and policy compliance
 





 • Coordinate inventory planning, product launches, and marketplace activities
 





 • Analyze marketplace performance and prepare regular reports
 





 • Develop strategies to achieve sales, growth, and profitability targets
 





 • Coordinate with Finance, Supply Chain, Design, Customer Support, and Product teams
 




  






 ✅ Requirements
 





 • Minimum 2 years of Amazon Marketplace experience – Mandatory
 





 • 1\+ year of international Amazon experience preferred
 





 • Strong hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon PPC
 





 • Good knowledge of catalog management, pricing, promotions, and Account Health
 





 • Experience with Amazon UK, Europe, or GCC is preferred
 





 • Strong analytical skills with good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets
 





 • Strong communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities
 





 • Target\-oriented with strong ownership of marketplace performance
 





 • Ability to work independently and take responsibility for business results
 





 • Willingness to relocate to Calicut is mandatory
 




  






 🌟 What We Offer
 





 ✔ ₹25,000 – ₹35,000/month
 





 ✔ Company\-provided accommodation
 





 ✔ Career growth opportunities
 





 ✔ Exposure to international Amazon marketplaces
 





 ✔ Opportunity to work with a growing Ecommerce \& Consumer Electronics business
 





 ✔ Performance\-driven professional environment
